 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separators are full rows/columns of the frame color (8 in this task).
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            row.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
        tiles.append(row)
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]
    nr, nc = len(tiles), len(tiles[0])
    # Complete every 2x2 tile motif by reflections across its inner dividers.
    for r in range(nr-1):
        for c in range(nc-1):
            cells = [(r,c), (r,c+1), (r+1,c), (r+1,c+1)]
            colors = set()
            for rr,cc in cells:
                a,b,x,y = tiles[rr][cc]
                colors.update(v for line in grid[a:b] for v in line[x:y] if v not in (0,8))
            for color in colors:
                occ = []
                for rr,cc in cells:
                    a,b,x,y = tiles[rr][cc]
                    occ.append(any(grid[i][j] == color for i in range(a,b) for j in range(x,y)))
                if sum(occ) != 3:
                    continue
                missing = occ.index(False)
                mr, mc = cells[missing]
                # Any occupied tile determines the missing tile by reflecting
                # over whichever of the two inner dividers are crossed.
                for src_idx, present in enumerate(occ):
                    if not present:
                        continue
                    sr, sc = cells[src_idx]
                    a,b,x,y = tiles[sr][sc]
                    da,db,dx,dy = tiles[mr][mc]
                    if b-a != db-da or y-x != dy-dx:
                        continue
                    flipud = sr != mr
                    fliplr = sc != mc
                    for i in range(b-a):
                        for j in range(y-x):
                            val = grid[b-1-i if flipud else a+i][y-1-j if fliplr else x+j]
                            if val == color:
                                out[da+i][dx+j] = color
                break
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
